name: Dimension Totsu Lovers!!
original_name: ディメンション凸ラバース！！
source:
200 years have passed since humanity was driven to the brink of extinction by the “monsters”—anti-reality disasters unleashed across the entire globe by the Black Train. Japan has been rebuilt by an anti-reality organization known as the “Academy”.
Yet darkness always lurks beneath a peaceful world. There are outlaws called “Mages” who cast aside human decency in the name of pursuing truth. The protagonist, [url=/c161706]Houzuki Enju[/url], is one such Mage—and an enemy of mankind.
“My son, infiltrate the Academy and assassinate [url=/c161702]Yoruno Sakura[/url], the student council president.”
Enju is stunned by his father’s order. Until now, he has done nothing but bury himself in magical research, with not a single friend. Socially awkward and utterly naive to the outside world, he has no way to pass himself off as an ordinary student and sneak into the Academy.
But what shocks him even more is the name Yoruno Sakura. It is none other than the girl he fell madly in love with at first sight just days earlier—the girl of his first love.

[Translated from [url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
人类被“怪物”——黑色列车在全球范围内引发的反现实灾难——逼至灭绝的边缘已经过去了200年。日本是由一个名为“学园”的反现实组织重建的。
然而，和平的世界之下总是潜伏着黑暗。有一些被称为“法师”的不法之徒，他们以追求真理的名义抛弃了人类的尊严。主角，[url=/c161706]凤月圆珠[/url]，就是这样一位法师——也是人类的敌人。
“我的儿子，潜入学院并刺杀[url=/c161702]夜野樱[/url]，学生会主席。”
恩珠对父亲的命令感到震惊。到目前为止，他什么也没做，只是埋头于魔法研究，没有一个朋友。社交上的尴尬和对外界的天真无知，让他无法冒充普通学生潜入学院。
但更让他震惊的是夜野樱这个名字。正是几天前他一见钟情的女孩，他的初恋女孩。

[翻译自[url=https://crystalia.amusecraft.com/totsulover/index.html]官网[/url]]
